resolution: Not a defect but a standing design note: the sede accepted the locally rendered, PAdES-signed request document on 2026-10-05 (REGAGE26e00086595724) and no DGSFP objection has been recorded since. The equivalence claim (title, visible sections and fields, attachment names and SHA-256 hashes, HMAC HUELLA, header, footer, page numbers; hidden sections and ocultarInformeFinal fields left out) is now pinned by src/dgsfp/builders/buildRequestDocument.test.ts. Open a new item if the DGSFP objects.
